meta.name: Monitor engineering health with ClickUp, GitHub, security and APM APIs, and WhatsApp

parameters.content:
## AI Software Engineering Control Tower

One orchestration layer polls ClickUp (delivery), GitHub (code/PRs/CI), a security scanner, and an APM/monitoring endpoint every run, computes a single 0-100 Engineering Health Score, and triggers autonomous workflows when the score or an individual pillar crosses a threshold: overdue-task escalation, stale/blocked PR nudges, failing-pipeline alerts, vulnerable-dependency flags, and production error/latency spikes — plus a genuine loop for the worst cases (alert -> human acknowledges -> grace period -> automatic re-check -> close or re-escalate).

### How to set up
1. Import this workflow into n8n
2. Add credentials: ClickUp API, GitHub API, your security scanner API (e.g. Snyk/Dependabot-style), your APM/monitoring API (e.g. Datadog/New Relic-style), and WhatsApp Business Cloud API on every WhatsApp node
3. Edit Set - Config: clickupTeamId/clickupListId, repoOwner/repoName, securityApiUrl, monitoringApiUrl, whatsappBusinessPhoneId, whatsappRecipientPhone, health score thresholds
4. Point Wait - For Incident Acknowledgement's resume webhook at your on-call tool's 'acknowledge' action
5. Activate the workflow, or use the Manual Trigger to test end to end

### Requirements
- ClickUp API access (tasks/lists)
- GitHub API access (PRs, commits, Actions/CI runs)
- Security scanner API access (dependency/vuln findings)
- APM/monitoring API access (error rate, latency, uptime)
- WhatsApp Business Cloud API credentials

### How to customize
- Add more pillars (e.g. test coverage, code review SLA) to the health-score code node
- Adjust pillar weights and severity thresholds in JS - Compute Engineering Health Score
- Wire Wait - For Incident Acknowledgement's webhook to Slack/PagerDuty instead of manual resume
- Extend JS - Detect Cross-System Issues with your own correlation rules (e.g. failing CI + overdue ClickUp task = same feature at risk)

## 1. Trigger & Data Collection

Set - Config centralizes every API URL/ID and the WhatsApp sender details.

Four parallel HTTP Request nodes pull the raw state of the engineering org:
- HTTP Request - Fetch ClickUp Tasks (delivery: overdue/blocked tasks)
- HTTP Request - Fetch GitHub Pull Requests (code: open/stale/unreviewed PRs)
- HTTP Request - Fetch CI/CD Pipeline Runs (build/test health)
- HTTP Request - Fetch Security Findings (vulnerable dependencies/secrets-style findings)
- HTTP Request - Fetch Monitoring Metrics (production error rate/latency/uptime)

Merge - Combine All Sources joins all five into one item per run so the scoring code node sees the whole picture at once.

## 2. Scoring & Cross-System Correlation

JS - Compute Engineering Health Score is the first code node: scores five weighted pillars (Delivery/ClickUp, Code/PRs, CI-CD, Security, Production) each 0-100, combines them into one overall score, and flags which pillars are 'at risk' (below their own threshold).

JS - Detect Cross-System Issues is the second code node: looks for correlations a single-system view would miss — e.g. a task that's overdue in ClickUp AND has a failing CI run on its linked branch, or a security finding in a service that's also showing elevated production error rate. Each correlated issue becomes its own item alongside the overall score item.

Switch - Route By Overall Health is the first switch: critical/degraded scores continue into the alert path; healthy scores go straight to the digest log.

## 3. Alert Routing & Remediation Loop

Switch - Route By Overall Health: critical -> urgent WhatsApp + incident loop; degraded -> standard WhatsApp notice; healthy -> logged only, no notification.

The incident loop (critical path only): WhatsApp - Send Critical Alert -> Wait - For Incident Acknowledgement (webhook resume from on-call tool) -> IF - Incident Acknowledged (unacknowledged loops back to the same Wait after a reminder) -> Wait - For Recovery Grace Period (a genuine TIME-based wait, not webhook resume) -> HTTP Request - Re-Fetch Health Signals -> back through JS - Compute Engineering Health Score (reused, tagged as a recheck pass) -> IF - Health Recovered decides between escalating again (score still critical) or closing the incident as recovered.

This mirrors the alert -> ack -> grace period -> re-verify -> close/escalate pattern, applied to overall engineering health instead of a single secret.
